capture_kind: material-claim ledger with selected public-page excerpts and metadata
scope: Material retention, deletion, legal, quality, and case claims in the trend section, sections 1-7, and selected appendix examples for voice-feature research. Appendix inventory links are not all duplicated here. This is not a full-page capture or provider-signed evidence.

case_inventory.counting_rule: One named real service, customer adoption, or operating case equals one case. Product feature and policy documents alone are excluded. Joint cases are counted once under the platform or ecosystem leading the customer workflow.

material_claims.statement: Raw audio, transcripts, and business outcomes can have different storage and deletion paths.
Retention and deletion differ by service mode, region, processing location, and controller or processor boundary, not merely by brand.
The task determines whether raw audio is deleted immediately or kept, what event starts the retention period, and whether that period is measured in hours, days, or years.
Deletion must be verified across derived artifacts, processors, compliance copies, and backups rather than inferred from user-interface state or one API response.
Notice, user controls, transcript access, audit, retention, and legal hold are separate control planes.
Transcripts, summaries, and voiceprints require separate accuracy, provenance, correction, presentation-attack, and alternative-authentication controls.
Service Connect calls are not recorded or stored unless the called company requests it; that company then acts as controller and Be My Eyes as processor.
Alexa turns voice requests into shopping lists, repeat purchases, and order workflows that persist separately from voice recordings.
Bixby controls SmartThings-linked consumer products while its US privacy notice separates command processing from optional review-recording retention.
LG publishes a consumer-product voice-control workflow and distinguishes local wake-word handling from an activated recognition session and its derived text.
Dyson Care uses Alexa to guide vacuum owners through product diagnostics while Alexa voice history and Dyson product or performance data remain separate policy domains.

Lemonade asks for a short claim video to understand and review the incident; retention is governed by purpose and legal, accounting, security, fraud, and reporting criteria rather than a published fixed TTL.
Erica voice interactions are saved for 90 days for accuracy analysis and retained transcripts have personal data masked.
Duolingo may store audio recordings and transcripts for AI features, while Math Tutor audio sent to Apple for recognition is immediately deleted and its transcript may remain.
PII deletion requires policies, rules, documentation, roles, and processes, while technical deletion mechanisms and their reliability require separate evidence.
A valid erasure process addresses live and backup systems; backup data that cannot be immediately overwritten must be put beyond use until replacement.
Korean AI law requires advance notice for generative or high-impact AI services and the current decree specifies notice, display, accessibility, and exception methods.
PIPC's 2026 user guide highlights training opt-out, conversation-history storage and deletion settings, and connected-service safety as user control issues.
Korean PIPA connects purpose and legal basis, outsourcing and overseas transfer, destruction, policy disclosure, and data-subject rights.
The EU AI Act distinguishes prohibited biometric emotion inference in workplace or education from general speech processing and separately imposes synthetic-content transparency duties.
The amended COPPA Rule treats a child's audio and voiceprints as personal information and provides only a narrow immediate-deletion exception for a specific request.
California law requires disclosure of each personal-information category's retention period or criteria and prohibits retention longer than reasonably necessary for the disclosed purpose.
The FTC Alexa case is an enforcement example where promised deletion practices and operational handling of children's voice data were challenged and an entered order required changes.
Korean ASR evaluation benefits from noise, speaker-characteristic, and text-error categories rather than one aggregate WER.
A 2020 US English study found materially different mean WERs across its Black and white speaker samples; the result is not a current Korean benchmark.
NIST SP 800-63B-4 prohibits voice-based biometric comparison within that digital-identity guidance, while ISO/IEC 30107-1 only defines a PAD framework.
Bixby, Gemini Live, ChatGPT Voice, Microsoft Copilot Voice Chat, and Siri use different raw-audio, transcript, improvement, and deletion policies by mode, account type, license, and service cloud.

Teams recording and transcript storage depends on meeting or call type. Copilot prompts and responses may be retained according to the organization's Purview configuration, while generated audio recap remains a separate artifact with its own availability and retention behavior.

Purview separates Copilot prompt-response compliance retention and permanent deletion from the message visibility shown in Teams or other Copilot interfaces; the result depends on tenant policy, holds, backend cycles, and supported service-cloud capabilities.
Copilot Studio temporary session or transcript storage, Dataverse transcript copies, maker access, Purview audit-event metadata, and retention of user or agent text are distinct control surfaces.

Dynamics 365 documents call recordings, call transcripts, Copilot Studio agent transcripts, analytics, summaries, and Copilot interaction rows as distinct records; whether deleting one propagates to the others requires separate verification.
Xbox's 2023 public rollout design kept a user-captured recent 60-second voice clip locally for 24 online hours and automatically erased an unsubmitted clip.

HMRC stores enrollment recordings and derived voiceprints in a UK data centre, refreshes consent after three years, keeps biometric data up to seven years, and deletes it on withdrawal or system replacement.

AXA UK records insurance calls and call metadata for standards, complaints, and fraud work, keeps quote and policy or claim records on separate schedules, and offers live video claim assessment whose own recording status is not published.
Aviva uses Verint to turn recorded insurance calls into transcripts and separate vulnerability or compliance flags, while the public customer stories do not publish storage or retention periods.

Kyobo Life uses AI voice bots and speech-to-text analysis for post-sale verification, script reading, notices, and full-population compliance review, while public sources do not state artifact storage or retention periods.

Samsung's global policy separates customer-service voice recordings, communication transcripts, and repair history, while Samsung Electronics Service Korea publishes statutory business-record periods that must not be treated as a fixed call-audio retention schedule.

LG Electronics operates a customer-service voice bot and separate remote-diagnostic and service-history workflows, but the cited public sources do not disclose raw-call recording, storage, or fixed retention.

The Beko Europe-operated Whirlpool and Wpro consumer call-center notice describes consent-based call recording and separate order or warranty-service records, with necessity-based rather than fixed call-recording retention.

sources.title: Be My Eyes Privacy Policy
sources.mode: Service Connect; separately, general calls and Be My AI
sources.section_locator: Your Data and Our Accessibility Services; retention section
excerpts: Be My Eyes does not record or store videos for Service Connect calls unless the Service Connect company asks us to.
The Service Connect company becomes the data controller; Be My Eyes becomes the data processor.
Be My Eyes retains call recordings indefinitely or within 30 days of receiving request to delete call recording(s) from a blind or low vision user.
Be My Eyes deletes Be My AI inquiries 60 days after creation, or within 30 days from receiving request from Blind or Low Vision user.
sources.qualification: General-call and Be My AI retention must not be applied to Microsoft Service Connect calls.

sources.title: Shop with Alexa
sources.mode: Echo voice request connected to Amazon or Alexa app lists and orders
sources.section_locator: Repeat Purchases; Grocery Shopping; Account & Orders
sources.excerpt: Add to your shopping list by voice while you make dinner and use it at any store (find it in your Amazon App).

sources.title: Alexa, Echo Devices, and Your Privacy
sources.mode: Account voice-history settings
excerpts: you can choose to automatically delete your voice recordings, text transcripts, and typed requests to Alexa after a specified period of time (3 or 18 months), or you can choose to not save any voice recordings
your text transcripts of those recordings and any typed requests will be retained for 30 days after your last interaction with Alexa in a given chat

We may still retain other records of your Alexa interactions, such as attachments you shared with Alexa, information you provided through your interactions, records of actions Alexa took in response to your requests, records of products you searched for, and other information related to your requests.
sources.qualification: Voice-history deletion does not cancel orders or necessarily delete shopping lists, action records, feedback copies, or third-party skill data.

sources.title: Lemonade FAQ
sources.mode: Mobile insurance claim
sources.section_locator: Why does Lemonade ask me to record a video during the claims process?
sources.excerpt: It only takes a minute to shoot the video. We’ll use your video solely for the process of handling or reviewing your claim.

sources.title: Lemonade Privacy Policy
sources.mode: Insurance and app services
excerpts: When contacting our customer service, or using any of the help features on our apps, we may use artificial intelligence and other automation technologies—in text, audio, or other formats—to help deliver a faster and better service.
We may also use these technologies for quality assurance and training.
sources.summary: The retention section uses a necessity test tied to the policy's purposes and legal, accounting, cyber, fraud-mitigation, and reporting requirements.
sources.qualification: The general retention clause does not establish a fixed TTL for claim videos.

sources.title: Erica - Virtual Financial Assistant
sources.mode: Authenticated Bank of America Mobile Banking app
sources.excerpt: Voice interactions are saved for 90 days so they can be analyzed to help refine Erica’s accuracy. When Bank of America retains transcripts of Erica interactions, personal data is masked.

sources.title: Duolingo Privacy Policy
sources.mode: Video Call and other AI features; Math Tutor; speaking activities
sources.summary: Duolingo may create, record, and store audio recordings or transcripts submitted to AI features and use them for improvement, personalization, and its own AI. For Math Tutor, audio is shared with Apple only for recognition and transcription and is immediately deleted, while the transcript may be retained, used, and shared. Users can skip speaking activities and opt out of improvement audio sharing.
sources.qualification: The policy does not publish one fixed raw-audio TTL for all AI conversation modes.

sources.title: Frequently asked questions about voice features in Microsoft 365 Copilot
sources.mode: Microsoft Copilot Voice Chat for users with a commercial Microsoft Copilot license; the cited FAQ says GCC and GCC High availability is future and gives no date
sources.section_locator: How does Microsoft store audio from users' voice chats with Copilot?
excerpts: Text transcripts from voice conversations are stored and managed in the same way as text conversations in the Microsoft Copilot app. No user or Copilot audio is stored.
If feedback is turned on, conversation audio is temporarily stored for users to provide feedback to Microsoft.
After 48 hours, this audio data is deleted.
sources.qualification: The 48-hour audio period applies only when feedback is turned on so the user can provide feedback to Microsoft. The cited page does not establish DoD availability.

sources.title: Gemini Apps Privacy Hub
sources.mode: Personal accounts; Keep Activity off or temporary chats; reviewed material separately
sources.section_locator: Privacy questions; text containing 72 hours and up to three years
excerpts: Temporary chats and chats you have when Keep Activity is off are retained with your account for 72 hours
Chats reviewed by human reviewers (and related data like your language, device type, location info, or feedback) are not deleted when you delete your activity.
Instead, they are retained for up to three years.

sources.title: Bixby U.S. Privacy Notice
sources.mode: United States; review-consent settings
sources.summary: The notice distinguishes request processing with raw-audio deletion from consented review recordings, which remain linked to an identifier for one month and retained for one year, with account-level consent controls.

sources.title: Bixby and SmartThings voice-control workflow
sources.mode: Samsung account and SmartThings-linked consumer products
sources.summary: Samsung states that Bixby automatically connects to SmartThings devices through the Samsung account and can control the smart home by voice; Bixby also controls selected apps and SmartThings-enabled devices.
sources.qualification: The workflow is global product guidance. The one-month and one-year recording periods come from the separate US Bixby notice and are not asserted as Korean retention periods.

sources.title: LG ThinQ ON product voice-control guides
sources.mode: Korean ThinQ app and ThinQ ON-linked products
sources.summary: LG shows voice control of registered consumer products such as air conditioners and provides an in-app guide listing supported products and commands.
sources.qualification: These Korean workflow pages do not publish a raw-audio retention period.

sources.title: Understanding Privacy on LG Smart TVs
sources.mode: United States; supported Smart TV voice-recognition modes
sources.summary: LG states that wake-word detection is local; audio without a recognized wake word is discarded without storage, transcription, or transmission; an active recognition session is capped at about 18 seconds and may produce speech-recognition text; offline voice data is not stored for later upload.
sources.qualification: This is a US Smart TV statement, not a fixed retention policy for every ThinQ product or Korean account.

sources.title: LG Global Privacy Policy
sources.mode: LG websites, accounts, application-based services, and products
sources.summary: LG lists speaker voice and translated text among information provided through its services and describes general purpose-based retention and data-subject rights.
sources.qualification: The general policy does not publish one raw-audio TTL for each product and voice mode.

sources.title: Support and control your Dyson technology with Amazon Alexa
sources.mode: Dyson Care skill for cordless floorcare owners
sources.excerpt: Cordless floorcare owners can now say, “Alexa, open Dyson Care” to address their vacuum’s performance, power, or visible issues. Alexa from Amazon guides owners through step-by-step diagnostics to identify problems and ways to resolve them.

sources.title: Dyson smart machines notice
sources.mode: MyDyson app, connected products, and linked voice assistants
sources.summary: Dyson describes product settings, sensor, usage, and performance data used for operation, support, reliability, and future-product improvement, and says data is shared where a user links a voice assistant.
sources.qualification: The notice does not publish a Dyson Care raw-voice retention period; Alexa voice history remains governed by Amazon's separate policy.

sources.title: ChatGPT Voice
sources.mode: Live, Advanced Voice, and Standard voice modes
sources.summary: The policy distinguishes audio clips linked to transcripts, a 30-day clip period, Standard audio deletion after transcription, training choices, and security or legal exceptions.

sources.title: Siri, Dictation & Privacy
sources.mode: Device and server processing; improve Siri and Dictation choice
sources.summary: Apple describes supported on-device processing, no Apple storage of audio when improvement is not enabled, request-history retention, reviewed samples, and device controls for deleting Siri and Dictation history.

sources.title: 개인정보 보호법
excerpts: 개인정보처리자는 보유기간의 경과, 개인정보의 처리 목적 달성 ... 그 개인정보가 불필요하게 되었을 때에는 지체 없이 그 개인정보를 파기하여야 한다.
개인정보를 국외로 제공(조회되는 경우를 포함한다)·처리위탁·보관
sources.qualification: Each legal basis, exception, and right must be applied to the actual workflow; this is not a universal audio TTL.

sources.title: 인공지능 발전과 신뢰 기반 조성 등에 관한 기본법
excerpts: 인공지능사업자는 고영향 인공지능이나 생성형 인공지능을 이용한 제품 또는 서비스를 제공하려는 경우 제품 또는 서비스가 해당 인공지능에 기반하여 운용된다는 사실을 이용자에게 사전에 고지하여야 한다.
인공지능사업자는 생성형 인공지능 또는 이를 이용한 제품 또는 서비스를 제공하는 경우 그 결과물이 생성형 인공지능에 의하여 생성되었다는 사실을 표시하여야 한다.
sources.qualification: A purchasing or support assistant is not high-impact merely because it talks to customers; Article 2(4)'s listed domain and material-impact test must be assessed.

sources.title: 인공지능 발전과 신뢰 기반 조성 등에 관한 기본법 시행령
sources.summary: Article 23 allows notice in the product, contract, manual, terms, screen, device, or service location; permits human-readable or machine-readable marking with an announcement at least once; requires accessible presentation; and defines obvious-use, internal-use, and ministerial exceptions.

sources.title: 생성형 AI 서비스 이용자를 위한 개인정보 보호 가이드
sources.section_locator: Official press release and attached user guide
sources.excerpt: 특히, 옵트아웃(학습활용 거부) 및 대화 기록 저장·삭제 설정 등 이용자가 직접 확인하고 통제할 수 있는 기능을 함께 안내했다.
sources.qualification: This is user guidance and a design reference, not a replacement for statutory controller obligations.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
sources.summary: Article 5 prohibits biometric emotion inference in workplace and education except for medical or safety reasons. Article 50 assigns AI-interaction and synthetic-content transparency duties to providers and deployers with specified exceptions. Article 113 applies Chapters I and II from 2025-02-02 and the regulation generally from 2026-08-02.

sources.title: Children's Online Privacy Protection Rule
sources.compliance_scope: Some Safe Harbor provisions have separate timing.
sources.excerpt: Where an operator collects an audio file containing a child's voice, and no other personal information, for use in responding to a child's specific request and where the operator does not use such information for any other purpose, does not disclose it, and deletes it immediately after responding to the child's request.
sources.qualification: Notice under 312.4(d) remains required. This is not a general exception for QA, training, or long-term recordings.

sources.title: California Civil Code 1798.100
sources.excerpt: The length of time the business intends to retain each category of personal information ... or if that is not possible, the criteria used to determine that period provided that a business shall not retain ... for longer than is reasonably necessary for that disclosed purpose.

sources.title: Amazon.com (Alexa), U.S. v.
sources.excerpt: The FTC will require Amazon to overhaul its deletion practices and implement stringent privacy safeguards to settle charges the company violated the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act Rule (COPPA Rule) and deceived parents and users of the Alexa voice assistant service about its data deletion practices.
sources.qualification: Distinguish complaint allegations, the entered stipulated order, and current product behavior.

sources.title: FTC and DOJ Charge Amazon with Violating Children's Privacy Law by Keeping Kids' Alexa Voice Recordings Forever
sources.summary: The FTC alleged that Amazon retained children's voice recordings, failed to fully honor deletion requests, and used retained data to improve Alexa. The proposed order required deletion of specified data and prohibited use of data subject to deletion requests for algorithm improvement.
sources.qualification: This summarizes regulator allegations and ordered remedies, not a technical audit of current Alexa behavior.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 27555:2021
sources.summary: The standard covers terminology, efficient deletion-rule definition, required documentation, and broad roles, responsibilities, and processes for PII deletion.
sources.qualification: It explicitly does not define national legal requirements, particular controller rules, deletion mechanisms, mechanism reliability or security, or de-identification techniques.

sources.title: ICO Right to erasure
sources.section_locator: Do we have to erase personal data from backup systems?
excerpts: you will have to take steps to ensure erasure from backup systems as well as live systems
The key issue is to put the backup data 'beyond use', even if it cannot be immediately overwritten.
sources.qualification: The guidance ties the exact steps to circumstances, retention schedules, technical mechanisms, and applicable exemptions.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-88 Rev. 2, Guidelines for Media Sanitization
sources.summary: Media sanitization renders access to target data on media infeasible for a given level of effort and supports a sanitization program based on information sensitivity.
sources.qualification: It is not an application-level logical-deletion, processor-propagation, or backup-restoration standard.

sources.title: KEBAP: Korean Error Explainable Benchmark Dataset for ASR and Post-processing
sources.summary: KEBAP defines 37 speech-level resources with diverse noise environments and speaker characteristics, 13 text-level error types, and validates the method on commercially deployed ASR systems.
sources.qualification: It supports evaluation design, not a performance claim about a specific implementation or a current vendor model.

sources.title: Racial disparities in automated speech recognition
sources.summary: Across 42 white and 73 Black US English speakers, five evaluated systems had mean WER 0.19 and 0.35 respectively.
sources.qualification: This is a historical US English sample, not a Korean or current-product benchmark.

sources.title: NIST AI 600-1, Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
sources.summary: A cross-sector companion to AI RMF 1.0 for managing risks specific to generative AI.
sources.qualification: Voluntary risk-management guidance; it does not set ASR or summary-accuracy pass thresholds.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-63B-4
sources.section_locator: Use of Biometrics / Presentation Attack Detection
sources.excerpt: Biometric comparison based on voice SHALL NOT be used.
sources.qualification: This applies within NIST digital-identity authentication guidance, not as a worldwide legal prohibition.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 30107-1:2023
sources.summary: The standard establishes terms and definitions for specifying, characterizing, and evaluating presentation attack detection methods.
sources.qualification: It covers attacks at the capture device and does not certify a particular voice-authentication deployment.

sources.title: Configure call recording, transcription, and real-time translation
sources.mode: Dynamics 365 voice workstream; Copilot Studio AI agents
sources.section_locator: Enable call recording and transcription for voice
sources.excerpt: Irrespective of whether you enable recording and transcription for voice, if you use AI agents created in Copilot Studio, a conversation transcript is automatically generated in Copilot Studio.
sources.metadata_scope: Identifiers published in the public Learn page; repository content was not independently inspected.

sources.title: Configure screen recording with desktop companion application
sources.mode: Desktop companion screen recordings and transcripts; not a universal call-audio retention rule
sources.section_locator: Set retention rules for screen recordings and transcripts
sources.excerpt: By default, screen recordings and transcripts are retained indefinitely. Copilot Studio transcripts are retained for 30 days. Configure retention rules by using Bulk Record Deletion jobs.
sources.qualification: These defaults are stated in the screen-recording document for its screen-recording and transcript records. Its 30-day Copilot Studio transcript statement, the up-to-28-day Copilot Studio temporary-store statement, and Dataverse transcript controls come from different document and record scopes and must not be merged or generalized to every call-audio artifact.
sources.metadata_scope: Identifiers published in the public Learn page; repository content was not independently inspected.

sources.title: Learn about retention for Copilot and AI apps
sources.mode: Microsoft Purview retention for Copilot experiences and AI apps
sources.summary: Purview retention covers user prompts and responses. Compliance copies are stored in a hidden Exchange mailbox folder and remain searchable through eDiscovery until permanent deletion; the message visible in an AI app is not an accurate indicator of compliance retention or deletion.
sources.qualification: The result depends on tenant policy configuration, holds, backend deletion cycles, licensing, and supported service-cloud capabilities. A one-day delete policy does not imply immediate permanent deletion.

sources.title: Teams meeting recording and transcript storage and permissions
sources.mode: Teams meetings, events, 1:1 and group calls, and channel meetings
sources.summary: Recordings and transcripts are stored in OneDrive or SharePoint. The organizer, recording initiator, meeting type, channel, and participant organization determine storage ownership and read, edit, sharing, or download permissions.
sources.qualification: Storage and permissions must be evaluated by meeting or call type rather than treated as one Teams-wide owner model. Availability can also differ by tenant, license, and service cloud.

sources.title: Use Copilot without transcribing or recording a Teams meeting or call
sources.mode: Copilot only during a Teams meeting or call
sources.summary: Copilot can generate notes and tasks without recording or transcription. Prompts and responses may still be retained in the Microsoft 365 compliance substrate and discoverable through Purview depending on the organization's retention-policy configuration.
sources.qualification: This is a tenant-policy-dependent possibility, not a universal compliance-copy guarantee. Feature availability also varies by license, meeting option, and service cloud.

sources.title: Control how transcripts are retained and accessed
sources.mode: Copilot Studio temporary session or transcript storage and separately controlled Dataverse transcripts
sources.summary: Session information used to support agent functionality is temporarily held in Copilot Studio storage, for which the page gives an automatic-deletion period of up to 28 days. Dataverse transcript saving, maker access, security roles, and Dataverse retention are separate controls; disabling future Dataverse saves can have a lag of up to 24 hours.
sources.qualification: Do not merge Copilot Studio temporary storage with the Dataverse transcript table. Dataverse for Teams environments and Microsoft Copilot agents are listed as exceptions to writing transcripts to the Dataverse transcript table.

sources.title: View Copilot Studio audit logs in Purview
sources.mode: Copilot Studio administrative, maker, and user-interaction activities
sources.summary: Copilot Studio emits administrative and interaction audit events to Purview. Interaction events contain metadata and a transcript thread ID, while full chat text is stored separately and may be retrieved through DSPM for AI.
sources.qualification: The page discusses retention of user and agent text separately from audit-event collection. Activity collection, Audit visibility, DSPM text access, and prompt-response retention are distinct controls; this ledger does not use the page to assert a universal zero-day deletion outcome.

sources.title: FAQ about the Dynamics 365 voice channel
sources.mode: Dynamics 365 Contact Center and Customer Service voice channel
sources.summary: Representatives can pause and resume recording and transcription to avoid sensitive information, and can pause transcription so DTMF tones are not captured. The document states that voice-channel data is stored in Dynamics 365 and can be scrubbed by the customer.

sources.title: Voice channel historical analytics and call insights
sources.mode: Dynamics 365 Contact Center voice analytics
sources.summary: Conversation intelligence derives performance and conversation-style metrics from call recordings, and supervisors can view full transcripts and verbatim text.
sources.qualification: Microsoft warns that these analytics are not intended for employment decisions and places notice, consent, monitoring, recording, and storage compliance on the customer.

sources.title: Download Copilot transcripts and interaction data
sources.mode: Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Contact Center Copilot data
sources.summary: Copilot transcripts, interaction data, events, feedback, and conversation summaries are stored in separate Dataverse tables. Ask-a-question chat transcripts can be downloaded from transcript-data rows, while summaries are stored in conversation-insight rows.
sources.qualification: The page establishes separate records and tables; it does not establish that deleting call audio automatically deletes every transcript, analytics, summary, interaction, or feedback record.

sources.title: Listen to audio recaps of your meetings
sources.mode: Teams Meeting Audio recap
sources.summary: Copilot can generate an audio recap from transcripts of up to eight meetings and stores it in the user's OneDrive. The support page states a default 120-day meeting-transcript period, allows earlier organizer deletion, and gives the generated audio recap a 60-day expiry.
sources.qualification: The published periods describe this feature's defaults and must not be generalized to every Teams transcript or tenant retention configuration; organization-level Teams and Purview policies require separate review.

sources.title: Xbox Launches New Voice Reporting Feature
sources.mode: Reactive in-game voice reporting
sources.summary: A player initiates capture of the previous 60 seconds for moderation. The clip cannot be downloaded, modified, or shared, remains accessible only to the player until submission, is not uploaded by Xbox before reporting begins, and is automatically erased from the console after 24 online hours if not reported.
sources.qualification: The 24-online-hour rule applies to the unsubmitted local clip. This records the 2023 design and selected-market rollout; it does not establish the submitted-clip retention period or every current region and UI's capture length.

sources.title: HMRC Voice Identification Privacy Notice
sources.mode: PAYE, Child Benefit, Self Assessment, Debt Management, and National Insurance helplines
sources.summary: HMRC records an enrollment phrase, converts it into a numerical voiceprint, stores biometric data in a UK data centre as controller, and uses a telephony service provider as capture and encryption processor. It refreshes consent after three years, stores biometric data for at most seven years without further contact, and deletes it on consent withdrawal or Voice ID system replacement.
sources.qualification: HMRC's statement that voiceprints cannot be replicated or stolen is a service claim, not a general technical assurance.

sources.title: How AXA UK collects data
sources.mode: UK insurance sales, service, claims, complaints, and fraud investigation calls
sources.excerpt: via our telephone calls with you, which may be recorded and this may include logging your telephone number, date, time and duration of the call
sources.summary: AXA says it mainly records calls to check internal and regulatory standards, investigate customer concerns, and identify or investigate fraud.
sources.qualification: The page confirms call recording and metadata but does not publish a fixed retention period for the call audio.

sources.title: AXA UK record keeping
sources.mode: UK insurance records
sources.summary: AXA publishes three years for quote information and up to ten years from the end of the relationship for policy and claims records, with longer periods for disputes or legal action.
sources.qualification: These are business-record schedules and are not stated as a fixed retention period for every call recording.

sources.title: AXA UK video claim assessment
sources.mode: Live home-insurance claim assessment
sources.excerpt: Simply choose a time that's convenient for you and our team will be on hand to carry out the inspection over a quick video call. We could even assess your claim on the same day.
sources.summary: A live video call can replace an in-person loss-adjuster visit and support a cash-settlement decision.
sources.qualification: The page does not state that the video call is recorded or publish a retention period for video.

sources.title: Aviva Life reimagines vulnerable customer experience with Verint Speech Analytics
sources.mode: UK insurance customer and adviser call analysis
sources.excerpt: Calls are typically transcribed within four hours of the live conversation. The calls are then analyzed to determine if they fall into one of the four U.K. Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) categories of potential vulnerability.
sources.summary: Recorded calls become transcripts and separate vulnerability, fraud-concern, high-risk, and compliance flags used in review and audit.
sources.qualification: Vendor-hosted named-customer case study; it does not publish storage location or retention periods.

sources.title: Kyobo Life opens an AI contact center

sources.title: Samsung Electronics Service Privacy Policy
